text:
Casey: Wow the fog is wild this morning, ferry barely visible from the dock. anyone on the 7:30 shuttle?
Priya: I was on it. driver took the scenic route because visibility was low, added ~18m. felt like ghost-ride. :fog:
Marco: Caltrain doing bus bridge at Millbrae due to signal issue, just fyi for anyone heading down the peninsula.
Quinn: Ugh bus bridge. my laptop bag is now a cuddle bear. :sob:
TransitBot: Shuttle update: 7:30 Redwood Shuttle delayed +18m due to low visibility. Caltrain bus bridging Millbrae <> Burlingame until 09:30. More: https://status.redwood.ai/transit
Priya: Also left my umbrella on the shuttle seat (classic). if someone finds a black compact near the second row pls ping.
Casey: I grabbed an extra box of bagels from the kiosk (plain, everything) 950 95e first come first serve at kitchen island.
Marco: Bless you. will bring coffee in trade. :coffee:
Quinn: If anyone's still working from home and wants to join the 10am sync, I'll host from the laptop in the cafe so people who show up late aren't penalized.
Priya: @Quinn that helps. might be 103 min late depending on the bus bridge.
TransitBot: Reminder: scooter riders, avoid Pier 33 underpass; water pooling reported, alternate: Embarcadero promenade.
Casey: Also FYI got a photo of the fog line looking like a low cloud shelf, will post in #photos later. ridiculous.
Marco: If someone picks up my umbrella, I will pay in bagels and eternal gratitude.
Quinn: Heads up to office plants: I'm watering the succulents bc visibility made me sympathetic. @OfficePlantsBot consider this manual override.
OfficePlantsBot: Thank you, Quinn. Succulents updated: watered by hand at 08:45. Reminder: next scheduled is Friday.
Priya: Who drove into the office earlier - any parking tips? the upper lot is partially closed for drainage.
Casey: Park at Lot C (background lot) and take the east stairs, they're dry. saved my shoes.
Marco: Thanks all. if anything else weird happens I'll update here. stay dry and bagel-hungry. :baguette_bread:
